home.intro: I’m Michael Lvov. My current project is a knowledge assistant built around retrieval, tool use, and durable conversation state.

founders.name: Michael Lvov
founders.bio: I’m a Principal Software Engineer with 20+ years building distributed systems and real-time data platforms across financial services, healthcare and e-commerce at Capital One, Amazon, Aetion and Flatiron Health. My work covers fault-tolerant streaming infrastructure, petabyte-scale data engineering and ML/NLP pipelines, including automated ingestion, data cleansing, normalization and ongoing pipeline maintenance.
founders.background: At Nora SuperIntelligence Lab, I independently built a self-hosted knowledge assistant with stateful agent workflows, document retrieval, persistent conversation state and failure recovery. I combine LangChain, LangGraph, Deep Agents and MCP with RAG, vector and hybrid retrieval, and context engineering. My work includes multi-provider model routing, bounded fallback, checkpoint recovery and evaluation of retrieval quality and failure behavior.
outcomes: At Capital One, modernized real-time streaming through partition optimization, backpressure tuning and autoscaling, increasing throughput from 1,000+ to 3,000+ TPS while reducing infrastructure costs by 30%.

At Aetion, built petabyte-scale healthcare ingestion and analytics platforms with a runtime customization engine that let client teams tailor pipelines through DSL/SQL and Airflow while reusing shared infrastructure.
In a previous engineering role, my AI-assisted workflows reduced diagnosis time and manual effort by 90%.

expertise.title: Distributed Systems & Real-Time Streaming
expertise.body: Fault-tolerant, horizontally scalable pipelines on Kafka, Spark Streaming and IBM MQ; partition optimization, backpressure management, automated recovery and performance tuning for financial and healthcare workloads.

expertise.title: Data Platforms & Knowledge Engineering
expertise.body: Petabyte-scale ingestion and analytics on Spark, Databricks and Redshift; multi-tenant isolation, domain-specific APIs, deterministic document preparation, chunking, embeddings and versioned retrieval indexes.

expertise.title: LLM Systems & Agent Orchestration
expertise.body: Stateful workflows, context engineering, persistent conversation state, provider routing and checkpoint recovery across application and service boundaries.

expertise.title: Retrieval & Evaluation
expertise.body: RAG, dense and lexical hybrid retrieval, vector search and BGE embeddings; reproducible embedding benchmarks, retrieval relevance metrics, regression tests and failure analysis that distinguish search quality from generated-answer quality.

expertise.title: Reliability, Observability & Release Engineering
expertise.body: Data-freshness and consumer-lag SLOs, distributed tracing, diagnostic automation and incident recovery; model-routing telemetry, containerized services, validated knowledge releases, atomic activation and rollback.

expertise.title: Regulated Data & Engineering Productivity
expertise.body: Financial and healthcare data pipelines with access controls, audit trails and data lineage; reusable AI-assisted workflows integrated into CI/CD, ticketing, monitoring and infrastructure troubleshooting.
